description: Deterministic and portable CWL v1.2 workflow that transforms supplied, source-linked GitHub evidence records into a topic-linked knowledge map, validates provenance and schema constraints, and reports explicit coverage gaps; no live collection, repository writes, biological inference or clinical analysis
name: Life Science Knowledge Workflow
tools: check the candidate schema and source-provenance contract
construct topic-linked source-cited knowledge and explicit coverage gaps
normalize supplied records and construct the deterministic evidence candidate
verify references, topic links, declared unknowns and structural integrity
